body:
twenty summers ago, taylor swift was an unknown 16-year-old playing an industry showcase almost nobody was watching.

two months before her debut album came out in october 2006, she performed at yahoo's "who's next?" program -- not a concert, not a red carpet, just a low-key spotlight for artists nobody had heard of yet. and mid-song she did something so her it's almost funny in hindsight: she rewrote one of her own lyrics on the spot to shout out yahoo music. yahoo's own retrospective still points to that moment as proof of how new and unpolished she was.

no eras tour. no stadiums. no cardigan. just a teenager with a guitar and enough nerve to rewrite her own line for the room she was in.

everybody starts somewhere. hers was a showcase most people skipped.
